content: Latent autoimmune diabetes in adults (LADA) is a form of autoimmune diabetes that develops more gradually in adults compared to the typical presentation of type 1 diabetes. This condition is characterized by a progressive destruction of pancreatic β-cells, which leads to a gradual decline in insulin production and function over time. Despite its later onset in life, LADA is classified under type 1 diabetes due to its autoimmune nature and underlying pathophysiology.
